parsed.explanation: For two equal columns and s=1, N(t)=2 throughout their height, so the odd-parity contribution is zero and never reaches d=T/3. Thus the prescribed cut is undefined, while Section 4 merely invokes lemma (i) and supplies no independent upper-bound argument. A one-sentence branch repairs this local gap: if the odd row never accumulates d, then (5) already gives Δ<d and no cut is needed; otherwise perform the stated cut and induction.
